description:
This position will function as PeopleSoft Developer responsible for: 
 -Delivering reliable, accurate and efficient solutions for the new development 
 -Writing formal technical documentation 
 -Developing and Unit Testing PeopleSoft programs/routines 
 -Break fix of program/routines 
 -Reporting work status to Supervisor on a regular basis, and responding quickly to management questions and concern 
 -Analyzing and develop the System (PeopleSoft and other Oracle products) using tools available (e.g., PeopleTools, PeopleCode, SQL, SQR, Unix Scripting, COBOL, Phire Architect or Stat) 

 Minimum 8 years relevant experience in the following areas( Min 5 years US exp ) 
 -Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining PeopleSoft applications using the following toolsets: Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interface, SQR, Application Messaging, and XML 
 -Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining applications using Oracle Database 10g or higher 
 -Thorough understanding of PeopleTools 8.53 or more, PeopleCode is a plus 
 -Demonstrated experience in an IT application development environment 
 -Demonstrated experience working in a team environment 
 -Demonstrated experience working and collaborating with others on solutions to develop effective and efficient solutions 
 
 Desired Qualifications: 
 -Seven (7) or more years of general applications development experience is desired 
 -Trained in Secure Coding Practices 
 At least one (1) year of experience in developing and maintaining PeopleSoft applications using the following skills and their toolsets: 
 -Integration Broker setup and Maintenance 
 -WSDL/Web Service Integration 
 -Experience with BI publisher is a plus 
 -Experience in PeopleSoft applications of HCM, Financials or CRM of 9.1 or higher 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 C2C
 
 USC/GC 
 
 
 DURATION: 6+MONTHS
